newsitem.title: SPAIN: Gran Canaria cargo traffic up 3.9 percent in July.
newsitem.headline: Gran Canaria cargo traffic up 3.9 percent in July.

text.p: Spain's Gran Canaria airport handled 3.9 percent more cargo in July compared with the same month last year, the island's airport authority said.
Volume rose to 2,386 tonnes compared with 2,297 tonnes, taking the accumulated total this year to 22,802 tonnes, 13.0 percent more than the same period in 1996.
The airport also handled 474 tonnes of mail in July, 4.5 percent less than in July 1996. The accumulated mail total was down 0.2 percent at 3,288 tonnes.

Passenger numbers were 1.0 percent higher in the month at 624,016 excluding transit passengers, taking the accumulated total to 4.51 million, 2.8 percent ahead of 1996. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
